title: Integration of Natural Logarithm via Parts
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

steps.title: Choose u = ln(x) and dv = dx
steps.mathExpression: u = \ln(x) \implies du = \frac{1}{x} dx; \quad dv = dx \implies v = x
steps.why: Standard strategy for single transcendental functions.

steps.title: Apply Parts Formula
steps.mathExpression: \int \ln(x) dx = x \ln(x) - \int x \left(\frac{1}{x}\right) dx = x \ln(x) - \int 1 \, dx

steps.title: Integrate 1
steps.why: Final standard antiderivative of natural log.
